description: Default capabilities for the Auffi sharer webview — minimum set actually invoked from JS: core IPC/events, the settings store, and https:// links to the project's About-page targets via the shell plugin. The file dialog and the pause hotkey are driven purely from Rust (DialogExt / GlobalShortcutExt), which does not go through this ACL, so no dialog/global-shortcut grants are needed here.
